Colorblind-safe categorical palette for drugsens plots

Source: R/zzz.R
drugsens_palette.Rd

An 8-color categorical palette ordered for high contrast and color-vision deficiency (CVD) safety across adjacent levels.

Usage

drugsens_palette

Format

A named character vector of 8 hex color codes: blue, orange, aqua, yellow, magenta, green, violet, red.

Examples

drugsens_palette
#>      blue    orange      aqua    yellow   magenta     green    violet       red 
#> "#2a78d6" "#eb6834" "#1baf7a" "#eda100" "#e87ba4" "#008300" "#4a3aa7" "#e34948"
